name: Awashimaura (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Awashimaura village emblem in yellow: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird above a mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Awashimaura, a village in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 December 1985.

features.role: Awashimaura village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird above a mountain
